limitations: Pregame expectation is the equal-weight mean of the Jets' and opponent's season-to-date EPA rates through the previous week; it is a descriptive reference, not a calibrated win or scoring forecast.
A game is reviewed only when the Jets game-level play-by-play metrics are present.
Player tables are descriptive production leaders, not causal impact grades; missing player-stat rows are not converted to zero.
Exact down-and-distance, formation, coverage-call and on-play personnel attribution require play-level source fields and are not inferred from aggregate game metrics.
Defensive EPA is interpreted in the opposite direction: lower actual EPA allowed than the pregame baseline is favourable.
